The '''Victoria sandwich''' (also known as the '''Victoria sponge''') is a Victorian [[Cookbook:Cake|cake]] that is popular in the UK.

==Ingredients==
* 170 [[Cookbook:Gram|g]] (⅔ [[Cookbook:Cup|cup]] or 6 [[Cookbook:Ounce|oz]]) [[Cookbook:Self-rising Flour|self-raising flour]]
* 170 g (⅔ cup or 6 oz) unsalted [[Cookbook:Butter|butter]] or [[Cookbook:Margarine|margarine]]
* 170 g (⅔ cup or 6 oz) [[Cookbook:Castor Sugar|caster sugar]]
* 3 [[Cookbook:Egg|eggs]] (170 g without shell)
* 1 [[Cookbook:Teaspoon|tsp]] [[Cookbook:Vanilla|vanilla essence]]
* Fruit [[Cookbook:Jam|jam]]
* [[Cookbook:Whipped Cream|Whipped cream]] or [[Cookbook:Buttercream|buttercream]]

==Equipment==
* 1 [[Cookbook:Mixing bowl|mixing bowl]]
* 1 [[Cookbook:Wooden Spoon|wooden spoon]]
* 1 [[Cookbook:Dull Knife|table knife]]
* 1 [[Cookbook:Offset Spatula|palette knife]]
* 2 [[Cookbook:Each|ea]]. 18 [[Cookbook:Centimeter|cm]] (7 [[Cookbook:Inch|in]]) circular [[Cookbook:Cake Pan|cake pans]]
* 1 [[Cookbook:Cooling rack|cooling rack]]

==Procedure==
#Preheat the [[Cookbook:Oven|oven]] to [[Cookbook:Oven temperatures|200°C (400°F or Gas Mark 6)]].
#[[Cookbook:Creaming|Cream]] the butter and sugar into a bowl and mix with a wooden spoon until softened. 
#Add the 3 eggs, the vanilla essence, and the flour and mix until smooth.
#Divide the mixture between the two greased [[Cookbook:Cake Pan|cake pans]].
#[[Cookbook:Baking|Bake]] in the oven for 20–30 minutes (10–15 in a [[Cookbook:Convection Baking|fan-assisted oven]]) until firm to the touch.
#Leave to cool completely on a [[Cookbook:Cooling Rack|cooling rack]].
#Turn one cake upside down and spread jam and whipped cream over it. Then, place the second cake on top.
#Cut into wedges, and serve.

steps.text: Preheat the oven to 200°C (400°F or Gas Mark 6).
Cream the butter and sugar into a bowl and mix with a wooden spoon until softened.
Add the 3 eggs, the vanilla essence, and the flour and mix until smooth.

Bake in the oven for 20–30 minutes (10–15 in a fan-assisted oven) until firm to the touch.
Leave to cool completely on a cooling rack.
Turn one cake upside down and spread jam and whipped cream over it. Then, place the second cake on top.
